desc: Very strong Seafarer buff, limited, CC with Deep Freeze.

DeepFreeze.description: Freezes the target, increasing damage taken from $OnePieceCategory units.

passives.name: BrookPassive1
passives.description:
To units in range with the Unbound trait:
- +15% Damage
- +5% Range
To units in range without the Unbound trait:
- +30% Damage
- +10% Range

The first OnePieceCategory unit placed in this unit's range is designated as the BrookCaptain
The BrookCaptain gains:
- +20% Critical Chance
- +25% Critical Damage
If the BrookCaptain is removed from the map:
- Designate the closest OnePieceCategory unit as the BrookCaptain

Summoned units and clones do not receive these buffs directly and cannot become the BrookCaptain.

passives.name: BrookPassive2
passives.description:
This unit can switch between two melodies.

If the closest unit is a OnePieceCategory unit, switch to the BrookMelody1:
For this unit:
- +35% Damage
- +100% Critical Chance
- +15% Critical Damage
- Inflict DeepFreeze on attack
- DeepFreeze: Immobilizes enemies for 3s. OnePieceCategory units deal +20% damage to enemies afflicted with DeepFreeze

If the closest unit is not a OnePieceCategory unit, switch to BrookMelody2:
- This unit stops attacking
For all units in range:
- +20% Damage
- +5% Range
- +10% Critical Chance

Summoned units and clones are ignored when choosing a melody and do not receive Brew's Melody's buffs directly.

passives.name: BrookPassive3
passives.description:
On attack:
- FollowUpAttack with BrookEVO_Skill2

On FollowUpAttack:
- Creates an area within the AoE that lingers for 8s. Any enemy that enters this area is afflicted with DeepFreeze for 3s.
When this unit attacks an enemy within this area:
- Extend DeepFreeze duration by 1s (Extension Cap: 1)

If this unit attacks an enemy afflicted with DeepFreeze:
- Deals an additional instance of 30% damage to hit enemies
